why: A (universes at 0) is Proposition 9.6.5 and the formula of p. 457 in slice form. proposition_9_6_5: under HasGraphChartAt x, every open W ∋ x contains a finite top slice S for the class of i₀, at every x and for every Θ; the points of S are not claimed top-good. sum_class_eq_sum_of_isTopSlice and dimPart_topDim_eq_sum_slices: the formula Θ_k(x) = ∑_classes ∑_{y∈S} Θ(y). sum_class_eq_of_hasGraphChartAt and dimPart_topDim_eq_of_hasGraphChartAt: independence of the structure under HasGraphChartAt. B, as printed, says that at a top-bad x of a labelled structure of a branched Θ: (i) for every tangent class there are blocks partitioning I_k (not the class Ξ), indices i_e, and sequences of top-good points x^e_j → x with x^e_j ∈ M_i ↔ i ∈ I^e; (ii) for all such data Θ_k(x) = ∑_Ξ ∑_e Θ_k(x^e_j). B is false (not_B). With the blocks partitioning I_k, each inner sum is ∑_{i∈I_k} σ_i = Θ_k(x), so (i) and (ii) give Θ_k(x) = ♯classes · Θ_k(x). That fails for the trivial ep-groupoid of ℝ² with Θ = 1_{y=0} + 1_{y=x} at 0: 0 is top-bad and there are two classes, since the tangent lines ℝ(1,0) ≠ ℝ(1,1) (via chartVec_image_graph2). The data in (i) come from B itself. So A ⇒ B is false (not_A_to_B), and B ⇒ A holds only ex falso, which is vacuous: the relation A_narrower is purely formal. Against the intended reading (blocks partitioning Ξ, the blind's BIntended) the two are incomparable; no proof was attempted. A needs HasGraphChartAt (proved only in ℝᵐ) and gives finite slices without top-goodness or sequences, but holds at every x for every Θ and adds independence of the structure. BIntended needs no graph hypothesis but asks for top-good sequences, only at top-bad x of branched Θ, and does not claim independence.
B_issue: B formalizes literally the printed partition 'I_k = I¹ ⊔ ⋯ ⊔ I^p' (the blind author flags it as a misprint for Ξ = I¹ ⊔ ⋯ ⊔ I^p, which the project's Propositions.lean also lists among the possible misprints); as printed the claim is false (not_B, counterexample: two transverse lines in ℝ²). The intended reading is recorded separately as BIntended and was not compared.
